requirement.title: Professional scalable Graphics/Video Settings with low-spec floor protection
requirement.origin: Owner explicitly requested a professional Graphics/Video Settings system with a visually strong default, scalable higher-quality presets and Custom controls without weakening the 720p Low-Medium 30 FPS target-laptop floor.
requirement.intent: Give players safe, reversible control over presentation quality while preserving P1C01 visual identity and the permanent visual-economy doctrine: maximize visible beauty per measured CPU/GPU/VRAM cost and recover waste before sacrificing hero readability.
acceptance_criteria: Presets include Performance, Cinematic Balanced, High, Ultra and Custom.
Cinematic Balanced is the visually strong default direction; higher presets are opt-in.
The Windows DX11 1280x720 Low-Medium 30 FPS floor remains protected on the i7 Gen6 / 8 GB RAM / ~2 GB VRAM target class.
Display-mode changes use a preview, confirm, revert transaction and can recover from an unconfirmed mode.
Custom controls cover resolution/display mode, VSync/frame cap and the governed scalability groups without silently exceeding the chosen preset.
Lower-tier texture/shadow/view-distance/foliage anchors cannot drift without an explicit governed decision and exact-device evidence.
Runtime settings integration remains P1C01-only until Gate 6/7 allows later runtime chapters.

decision.title: P1C01 Graphics/Video settings use a visual-economy preset stack with reversible display transactions
decision.resolution: Implement the P1C01 Graphics/Video settings architecture around Performance, Cinematic Balanced, High, Ultra and Custom. Protect the current low-tier scalability floor and recover GPU/CPU/VRAM cost from waste before reducing hero silhouette, composition, hero materials, lighting, atmosphere or near-field detail.
implementation_contract: Preserve Windows / DX11 / 1280x720 Low-Medium / 30 FPS as the target-laptop floor contract.
Cinematic Balanced is the visually strong default; Performance is the recovery preset; High and Ultra are opt-in quality tiers; Custom exposes individual governed controls.

Preserve the existing lower-tier anchors: texture pool 600/800/1000 MB, shadow max resolution 512/768/1024, shadow/view-distance scale 0.45/0.65/0.80 and foliage tier-2 density 0.70 until measured evidence justifies a governed change.
Display resolution/window-mode changes use preview -> confirm -> revert; an unconfirmed or failed preview must restore the previous known-good mode.
Recover cost first from duplicate actors, far shadows, overdraw, translucency, redundant lights, uninstanced repetition, unnecessary Tick and invisible/far detail.
Protect silhouette, composition, hero materials, lighting, atmosphere and near-field detail ahead of indiscriminate detail reduction.
Heavy runtime assets remain soft referenced and asynchronously loaded through FStreamableManager; crowds stay pooled; repeated decorative detail stays ISM/HISM + LOD/culling.
Final animated assets remain FBX; production textures remain PNG/TGA/channel-packed.
Runtime implementation remains P1C01-only; later runtime chapters remain closed until Gate 6/7.
Ledger registration and this Governor authority must both be landed before runtime settings source opens.
decision.rationale: The project needs a player-facing quality system that preserves the established low-spec floor while spending performance budget where it creates the most visible cinematic value. A governed preset stack plus reversible display transaction prevents quality drift and unsafe display changes.
evidence: Docs/WORLD_DETAIL_LEDGER.md — P1C01 Graphics/Video Visual-Economy Doctrine V3 (must land before runtime implementation)
decision.evidence_boundary: GOVERNANCE ARCHITECTURE ONLY. No compile, PIE, device, visual or performance acceptance is claimed.

apply_rule: Fail closed if develop SHA, ProjectGovernor blob SHA, requirement availability, decision availability or required ledger registration has changed.
